name: error_ratio
query: (sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{route="/api/v1/orders",code=~"5.."}[2m])) or sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{route="/api/v1/orders"}[2m])) * 0) / sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{route="/api/v1/orders"}[2m]))

name: upstream_error_ratio
query: (sum by (upstream) (rate(upstream_requests_total{code!~"2.."}[2m])) or sum by (upstream) (rate(upstream_requests_total[2m])) * 0) / sum by (upstream) (rate(upstream_requests_total[2m]))
